1.t: By those who range themselves in ranks,

2.t: And so are strong in repelling (evil),

3.t: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!

4.t: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-

5.t: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!

6.t: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-

7.t: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,

8.t: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,

9.t: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,

10.t: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.

11.t: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!

12.t: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,

13.t: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-

14.t: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,

15.t: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!

16.t: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)

18.t: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."

19.t: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!

20.t: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"

21.t: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"

22.t: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-

23.t: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!

24.t: "But stop them, for they must be asked:

25.t: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"

26.t: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);

27.t: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.

28.t: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"

29.t: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!

30.t: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!

31.t: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).

32.t: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."

33.t: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.

34.t: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.

35.t: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,

36.t: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"

37.t: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).

38.t: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-

39.t: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-

40.t: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-

41.t: For them is a Sustenance determined,

42.t: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,

44.t: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):

45.t: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,

46.t: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),

47.t: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.

48.t: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).

49.t: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.

50.t: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.

51.t: One of them will start the talk and say: "I had an intimate companion (on the earth),

52.t: "Who used to say, 'what! art thou amongst those who bear witness to the Truth (of the Message)?

53.t: "'When we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed receive rewards and punishments?'"

54.t: (A voice) said: "Would ye like to look down?"

55.t: He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.

56.t: He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!

57.t: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been among those brought (there)!

58.t: "Is it (the case) that we shall not die,

59.t: "Except our first death, and that we shall not be punished?"

60.t: Verily this is the supreme achievement!

61.t: For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.

62.t: Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?

63.t: For We have truly made it (as) a trial for the wrong-doers.

64.t: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-Fire:

65.t: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of devils:

66.t: Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.

67.t: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture made of boiling water.

68.t: Then shall their return be to the (Blazing) Fire.

69.t: Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;

70.t: So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!

71.t: And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-

72.t: But We sent aforetime, among them, (messengers) to admonish them;-

73.t: Then see what was the end of those who were admonished (but heeded not),-

74.t: Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah.

75.t: (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, and We are the best to hear prayer.

76.t: And We delivered him and his people from the Great Calamity,

77.t: And made his progeny to endure (on this earth);

78.t: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations to come in later times:

79.t: "Peace and salutation to Noah among the nations!"

80.t: Thus indeed do we reward those who do right.

81.t: For he was one of our believing Servants.

82.t: Then the rest we overwhelmed in the Flood.

83.t: Verily among those who followed his Way was Abraham.

84.t: Behold! he approached his Lord with a sound heart.

85.t: Behold! he said to his father and to his people, "What is that which ye worship?

86.t: "Is it a falsehood- gods other than Allah- that ye desire?

87.t: "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"

88.t: Then did he cast a glance at the Stars.

89.t: And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"

90.t: So they turned away from him, and departed.

91.t: Then did he turn to their gods and said, "will ye not eat (of the offerings before you)?...

92.t: "What is the matter with you that ye speak not (intelligently)?"

93.t: Then did he turn upon them, striking (them) with the right hand.

94.t: Then came (the worshippers) with hurried steps, and faced (him).

95.t: He said: "Worship ye that which ye have (yourselves) carved?

96.t: "But Allah has created you and your handwork!"

97.t: They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"

98.t: (This failing), they then sought a stratagem against him, but We made them the ones most humiliated!

99.t: He said: "I will go to my Lord! He will surely guide me!

100.t: "O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!"

101.t: So We gave him the good news of a boy ready to suffer and forbear.

102.t: Then, when (the son) reached (the age of) (serious) work with him, he said: "O my son! I see in vision that I offer thee in sacrifice: Now see what is thy view!" (The son) said: "O my father! Do as thou art commanded: thou will find me, if Allah so wills one practising Patience and Constancy!"

103.t: So when they had both submitted their wills (to Allah), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (for sacrifice),

104.t: We called out to him "O Abraham!

105.t: "Thou hast already fulfilled the vision!" - thus indeed do We reward those who do right.

106.t: For this was obviously a trial-

107.t: And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice:

108.t: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:

110.t: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.

111.t: For he was one of our believing Servants.

112.t: And We gave him the good news of Isaac - a prophet,- one of the Righteous.

113.t: We blessed him and Isaac: but of their progeny are (some) that do right, and (some) that obviously do wrong, to their own souls.

114.t: Again (of old) We bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron,

115.t: And We delivered them and their people from (their) Great Calamity;

116.t: And We helped them, so they overcame (their troubles);

117.t: And We gave them the Book which helps to make things clear;

118.t: And We guided them to the Straight Way.

119.t: And We left (this blessing) for them among generations (to come) in later times:

120.t: "Peace and salutation to Moses and Aaron!"

121.t: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.

122.t: For they were two of our believing Servants.

123.t: So also was Elias among those sent (by Us).

124.t: Behold, he said to his people, "Will ye not fear (Allah)?

125.t: "Will ye call upon Baal and forsake the Best of Creators,-

126.t: "Allah, your Lord and Cherisher and the Lord and Cherisher of your fathers of old?"

127.t: But they rejected him, and they will certainly be called up (for punishment),-

128.t: Except the sincere and devoted Servants of Allah (among them).

129.t: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:

130.t: "Peace and salutation to such as Elias!"

131.t: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.

132.t: For he was one of our believing Servants.

133.t: So also was Lut among those sent (by Us).

134.t: Behold, We delivered him and his adherents, all

135.t: Except an old woman who was among those who lagged behind:

137.t: Verily, ye pass by their (sites), by day-

138.t: And by night: will ye not understand?

139.t: So also was Jonah among those sent (by Us).

140.t: When he ran away (like a slave from captivity) to the ship (fully) laden,

141.t: He (agreed to) cast lots, and he was condemned:

142.t: Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.

143.t: Had it not been that he (repented and) glorified Allah,

144.t: He would certainly have remained inside the Fish till the Day of Resurrection.

145.t: But We cast him forth on the naked shore in a state of sickness,

146.t: And We caused to grow, over him, a spreading plant of the gourd kind.

147.t: And We sent him (on a mission) to a hundred thousand (men) or more.

148.t: And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.

149.t: Now ask them their opinion: Is it that thy Lord has (only) daughters, and they have sons?-

150.t: Or that We created the angels female, and they are witnesses (thereto)?

151.t: Is it not that they say, from their own invention,

152.t: "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!

153.t: Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?

154.t: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?

155.t: Will ye not then receive admonition?

156.t: Or have ye an authority manifest?

157.t: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!

158.t: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!

159.t: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!

160.t: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.

161.t: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-

162.t: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,

163.t: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!

164.t: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;

165.t: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);

166.t: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"

167.t: And there were those who said,

168.t: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,

169.t: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"

170.t: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!

171.t: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),

172.t: That they would certainly be assisted,

173.t: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.

174.t: So turn thou away from them for a little while,

175.t: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!

176.t: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?

177.t: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!

178.t: So turn thou away from them for a little while,

179.t: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!

180.t: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!

182.t: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.
